policy.lookback: No fixed look-back window is imposed because the Consortium's FAQ does not prescribe one. Select stories for significance and continuing relevance, not merely date proximity.
policy.primarySourceRule: Use official records as the factual anchor. Secondary exam-preparation digests may help discover themes, but must not be the sole factual authority.
policy.passageDesign: Original journalistic-style passage, up to approximately 450 words; explain the event, institutional background, implications and one or more competing considerations. Test passage comprehension plus only the static GK supplied or clearly established in the passage.
policy.prohibited: No invented dates, office-holders, statistics, treaty outcomes, legal holdings or speculative predictions. Do not present a pending proposal as enacted law. Every changing fact needs an as-of date.

facts: Budget presented on 1 February 2026 by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman.
The Budget summary described three Kartavya priorities: sustaining growth; fulfilling aspirations/building capacity; and the vision of Sabka Sath, Sabka Vikas.
The Income-tax Act, 2025 was stated to come into effect from April 2026.
The Budget included tax, customs, safe-harbour and manufacturing measures; each figure must be checked against the specific budget document before use.
topics.checks: Do not confuse a budget announcement with later implementation rules; verify figures against the speech or Finance Bill.

topics.theme: Supreme Court and AI-generated fake legal citations
facts: Pooja Ramesh Singh v Jammu and Kashmir Bank Ltd, 2026 INSC 668, dated 2 July 2026.
The Supreme Court addressed reliance on AI-generated fake or hallucinated case citations in tribunal decisions.
Questions should focus on judicial verification, authenticity of precedent and institutional responsibility; do not invent sanctions or directions not stated in the judgment.
topics.checks: Use the Court's summary and link through to the full judgment; carefully distinguish a case-specific outcome from general guidance.

topics.theme: Bihar Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls
facts: Association for Democratic Reforms v Election Commission of India, 2026 INSC 564, dated 27 May 2026.
The case considered the Election Commission's authority, the Representation of the People Act, 1950, proportionality and the electoral-roll revision process.
The Court discussed Articles 324, 325, 326 and 327 and Section 21(3) of the 1950 Act.
topics.checks: Do not overstate the ruling as a general power to determine citizenship. Questions must stick to the Court's stated scope and safeguards.

facts: Harish Rana v Union of India, 2026 INSC 222, dated 11 March 2026.
The Court considered withdrawal of clinically assisted nutrition and hydration and the best-interests standard for a patient lacking decision-making capacity.
The Supreme Court summary reiterates strict safeguards, medical-board assessment, palliative support and the importance of medical and non-medical factors.
topics.checks: Preserve the distinction between active euthanasia and withholding/withdrawing life-sustaining treatment; do not simplify the safeguards.

facts: At its 5–7 October 2026 meeting, the MPC raised the policy repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%.
The Standing Deposit Facility rate became 5.25%; the MSF rate and Bank Rate became 5.75%.
The MPC changed its stance to calibrated tightening; two members preferred retaining neutral stance.
topics.checks: As-of values change. Date-stamp the rate in every passage and never treat this as a live current rate after the as-of date.

topics.theme: COP17 biodiversity conference and Yerevan Pathway
facts: COP17 of the Convention on Biological Diversity took place in Yerevan, Armenia, 19–30 October 2026.
It marked the first global review of collective progress towards the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework.
The UN described a Yerevan Pathway to accelerate action for nature after the review found the world off track.
topics.checks: Distinguish CBD COP from UNFCCC climate COP. Verify the final decision text before asking about any numerical target or funding commitment.

facts: GSLV-F18 successfully placed NVS-03 into its intended orbit on 28 October 2026.
NVS-03 is the third satellite in the next-generation navigation satellite system intended to provide continuity of navigation services for the IRNSS series.
The satellite includes an indigenous atomic clock and L1 signal in addition to L5/S signals.
topics.checks: Do not confuse the navigation satellite with a communications or Earth-observation mission; check payload details against ISRO.

facts: The four-day summit took place 2–5 November 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
The stated theme was Invest. Innovate. Inspire.
PIB reported participation from 135 countries and 75,000+ visitors at the conclusion; these are organiser/government-reported figures.
topics.checks: Attribute participation numbers to PIB/organisers and avoid treating promotional targets as independently audited outcomes.

topics.theme: Corporate criminal liability and attribution of mens rea
facts: Sanofi India Ltd v Central Bureau of Investigation, 2026 INSC 957, dated 7 September 2026.
The Supreme Court summary addresses when alleged conduct and mens rea of natural persons may be attributed to a corporation.
The summary says bald allegations remain vulnerable to quashing and identifies a prima facie threshold.
topics.checks: Avoid treating the summary as permission to prosecute every corporation without a factual attribution foundation; verify exact paragraphs in the full decision.
